1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __for a predetermined time period while maintaining embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by disrupting cell walls of the shed cellular material__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __to determine genetic markers__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completing the molecular analysis__.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Original) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation.

6. (Original) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA.

10. (Original) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __from corn__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __in stasis storage__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __using PCR-based analysis__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __for breeding purposes__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __for breeding__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __at least semi-__automated.
